name: The Coastal Menace
summary: On Westfall's rocky shore, Captain Grayson's ghost calls travelers to face The Coastal Menace. His ship broke on the rocks after murlocs drove the lighthouse keeper's family from their post. The family returned, but Old Murk-Eye led another attack and killed them. Now Grayson seeks the chieftain's death and justice for the shore.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Dark
sections.body: The Westfall Lighthouse once guided ships through the jagged shallows along the southern coast. After murlocs frightened the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, Captain Grayson's ship struck the rocks in the dark. The family returned and lit the flame again, but danger still stalked the shore.

sections.title: The Scourge of the Coast
sections.body: Old Murk-Eye rallied the weaker-minded murlocs along the coast and led them against the lighthouse. In that second attack, the keeper's family died while Captain Grayson watched, helpless. Now the ghostly captain calls for Murk-Eye's death and asks for a scale as proof. He hopes to bring peace to the dead and protect sailors on the Great Sea.

faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye is a cunning murloc chieftain who prowls Westfall's southern coast. He rallies other murlocs and leads attacks on human settlements along the shore.

faq.q: Why does Captain Grayson want Old Murk-Eye dead?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson wants Old Murk-Eye dead because murlocs drove the lighthouse keeper's family from their post. With the shore dark, Grayson's ship struck the rocks. Later, Grayson watched Murk-Eye lead a second attack that killed the returned keeper and his family.

faq.q: Where can Old Murk-Eye be found?
faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye prowls Westfall's open beaches and shallows near the Westfall Lighthouse and nearby murloc encampments.

faq.q: What proof does Grayson ask for?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson asks for one scale from Old Murk-Eye as proof that the chieftain is dead.

faq.q: Who was Captain Grayson in life?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson was a sea captain whose ship struck the rocks below the Westfall Lighthouse. His spirit remains near the shore, seeking retribution against the murlocs and safer waters for passing vessels.

faq.q: What happened to the lighthouse keeper's family?
faq.answer: The lighthouse keeper's family first fled after Old Murk-Eye harassed the tower. They returned to relight the lantern, but Murk-Eye led a second attack that killed the whole family.

angles.text: Westfall's coastal waters carry vital shipping for Stormwind. Driving away leaders like Old Murk-Eye helps keep the southern sea routes safe from sabotage.
As a human, you know the lighthouse keeper's family's murder as a grim chapter in Westfall's loss of safety. Their deaths give you another reason to avenge your fellow citizens.
